map.由吸收剂量与品质因数求剂量当量 使用指南: Dose Equivalent from Absorbed Dose and Q - User Guide
map.输入吸收剂量 D 与辐射权重因子 Q（品质因数），按 H = D·Q 计算剂量当: Enter absorbed dose D and radiation-weighting factor Q (quality factor), and compute equivalent dose by H = D*Q (sievert Sv). Used to measure the equivalent harm of different radiation types to biological tissue, for radiation-protection evaluation.
map.输入吸收剂量 D 与辐射权重因子 Q，求剂量当量。: Enter absorbed dose D and radiation-weighting factor Q to compute equivalent dose.
map.吸收剂量 D × 辐射权重因子 Q 得当量剂量（Sv）。: Absorbed dose D * radiation-weighting factor Q gives equivalent dose (Sv).
map.不同辐射类型危害对比（α 的 Q 高）。: Comparison of hazards across radiation types (alpha has high Q).
map.：当量剂量 H = 2 × 20 = 40 Sv；同等 D 用 γ（Q=1）仅: : equivalent dose H = 2 * 20 = 40 Sv; same D with gamma (Q=1) is only 2 Sv.
map.：α 的 Q 可达 20，β/γ 多为 1，同样吸收剂量下 α 危害高 20 倍: : alpha Q can reach 20, beta/gamma mostly 1; under the same absorbed dose alpha is 20 times more harmful.
map.由物理与生物半衰期求有效半衰期: Effective half-life from physical and biological half-lives
map.由线性衰减系数与厚度求透射强度: Transmitted intensity from linear attenuation coefficient and thickness
map.由核数与活度反推半衰期: Half-life back-computed from nucleus count and activity
map.Sv 与 Gy 关系？: What is the relation between Sv and Gy?
map.Sv = Gy × Q；对 γ/β（Q=1）数值相等，α 因高 Q 危害更大。: Sv = Gy * Q; for gamma/beta (Q=1) values are equal, alpha is more harmful due to high Q.
map.Q 的取值？: What is the value of Q?
map.由辐射类型与能量决定，α 约 20、β/γ 约 1，具体以防护标准为准。: Determined by radiation type and energy: alpha about 20, beta/gamma about 1; follow the protection standard for specifics.
